Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. · Partner with Eng VPs and Directors to own PhD hiring strategy, shaping how Figma approaches and scales research talent across the org

· Lead Figma's presence at research conferences like NeurIPS, aligning stakeholders and running on-site logistics from booth setup to interviewer prep

· Own the publication process for PhD roles, partnering with hiring teams, legal, and senior leadership

· Mentor recruiters on the team supporting PhD efforts, growing the bench as the function scales

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

The recruiting team seeks to build the culture of Stripe by aligning the strongest global talent to our highest impact business needs. They focus on bringing Stripe’s operating principles to life in their recruiting processes, providing the highest-quality candidate experience, and leveraging data driven storytelling to influence the business.

To further this important mission, we are looking for consultative and creative recruiters to grow and scale our Go-to-Market (GTM) team. The GTM organization at Stripe encompasses our Sales team, Marketing and Sales Development, GTM and Product Operations, and Professional Services.

These teams are expanding in the region, focusing on bringing new users onto the Stripe platform, supporting our existing users' scale, and growing their businesses. You can expect high impact and wide-ranging responsibilities: owning full-cycle recruiting, driving hiring strategy, and delivering best-in-class candidate experience.

This person must be a builder who thrives in a learning environment—unafraid to try new things, embrace new ideas, and welcome suggestions for how we can iterate on our processes.

· Develop and execute strategic sourcing plans to identify and engage top talent, ensuring a robust and inclusive candidate pool for current and future hiring needs

· Conduct regular market research and analysis to stay informed about talent trends, using insights to inform recruiting strategies and address potential challenges

· Partner with senior leaders across the organization to understand their hiring objectives and develop recruiting strategies aimed at achieving headcount goals, with an emphasis on expanding our GTM teams across the US, LatAM and Canada

· Track and analyze recruiting metrics, providing regular reports on hiring progress to business leadership to ensure transparency and alignment with goals

· Propose and implement creative and scalable changes to the existing recruiting strategy to enhance efficacy and reach

· Work closely with cross-functional teams—including Finance, People Ops, Benefits, Onboarding, and Legal—to deliver a seamless and high-quality candidate experience

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

· 4+ years of full-cycle Recruiting experience in a fast-paced, high-growth environment including in house experience

· Excellent verbal and written communication skills

· Strong ability to build relationships with senior leaders and effectively influence decision-making processes

· Strong drive to identify and engage top talent, fostering relationships with candidates

· Proven ability to utilize data insights to identify trends and refine recruiting processes, enhancing efficiency and outcomes

· Flexibility, adept at shifting tasks and priorities in response to changing circumstances

· Proficiency with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS), such as Greenhouse, Lever, or similar platforms

· Experience leveraging sourcing and CRM tools (e.g., Gem, LinkedIn Recruiter) to build and manage talent pipelines

· Strong working knowledge of recruiting analytics and reporting tools to drive data-informed hiring strategies

· Familiarity with scheduling, communication, and collaboration tools (e.g., GoodTime, Slack, G Suite)

· Ability to quickly adopt new recruiting technologies and optimize workflows for scale

Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work.

We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains.

Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles.

We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

You don't need a perfect CV. You need the right skills.
This is not a role that filters by job title or tenure. It filters by what you can actually do.
We are looking for a recruiter who owns the full process — from the first Boolean search string to the signed offer, without
hand-holding, without process gaps, and without needing someone to define the search for them.
Skills are the filter, not biography. If you can demonstrate the capabilities below, we want to hear from you, regardless of how
your career path looks on paper.

You will be the driving force behind talent acquisition at a fast-growing, AI-powered HR Tech startup based in Berlin. This is an
internal recruiting role, not a staffing agency seat, not a volume-first environment.
You will own the complete hiring funnel: sharpen the role before searching, build and execute sourcing strategies, conduct
structured interviews, and manage stakeholders who need to be challenged, not just served.
Roles are thought of in terms of skill requirements, not job titles. The result is precision instead of volume. That's the standard
you'll work within and the standard you'll be held to.

A coordinator position waiting for candidates to come in
A reactive sourcing seat with no strategic mandate
A bureaucratic HR function with fixed playbooks and no autonomy

Full ownership of the recruiting process from identification to signed offer
A strategic partner seat, you challenge requirements, you advise, you deliver
A skill-first environment where your process quality matters more than your job title history
Your Skill Map
Core Skills are the central, non-negotiable capabilities of the role. Extended Skills are desirable additional competencies that
strengthen the profile but are not a knockout criterion.
Core Skills - KO Level
These are non-negotiable. If you cannot demonstrate these, this role is not a match.
Full-Cycle Recruiting Ownership
You independently drive the complete hiring process, from role clarification and sourcing strategy through structured
assessment to offer and close — without process gaps or handoffs mid-funnel.
What we look for: You can describe a search you ran end-to-end, including how you aligned the hiring manager on
requirements before searching, how you structured the funnel, and how you navigated blockers.
Active Sourcing via LinkedIn Recruiter
You can build and execute complex Boolean search strings from scratch, not just apply standard filters. You understand
how to construct multi-layer queries, use operators, and adapt strings to market signals.
What we look for: You can write a Boolean string for a target role live, explain the logic behind it, and describe how you would
adapt it if initial results are too narrow or too broad.
Competency-Based Interviewing
You conduct structured interviews using a defined competency framework. Your candidate assessments are evidencebased, documented, and defensible, not impressionistic.
What we look for: You can explain how you assess a specific competency in an interview, what question structure you use, and
how you document the evidence. You distinguish between self-reported claims and demonstrated behavior.
Stakeholder Advisory
You challenge hiring managers when role definitions are unrealistic, market expectations are off, or process decisions
create risk. You align before searching, not after.
What we look for: You can describe a situation where you pushed back on a hiring manager's position and explain how you
built the case and navigated the outcome.
Data-Driven Recruiting
You read, interpret, and act on funnel KPIs, time-to-hire, source-to-screen conversion, offer acceptance rates. You use
data to make process decisions, not just report them.
What we look for: You can describe a recruiting funnel metric you tracked, how you interpreted it, and what process change it
drove.
Language Skills — Non-Negotiable
German at C2 / native-equivalent level, required for candidate conversations, stakeholder communication, and process
documentation in a German-speaking context. English at C1+ level, required for written and verbal communication in an
international team environment.
AGG note: Both language requirements are professionally justified by the candidate-facing and client-facing nature of the role
Strong Skills - Valued, Not KO
These strengthen your application but will not exclude you if absent.
Talent Pool Architecture: You systematically build, segment, and maintain candidate pipelines for recurring roles, not ad hoc lists
AI & Tech Tool Affinity: You have hands-on experience with modern ATS systems and AI-assisted sourcing or matching tools
Employer Branding Contribution: You can co-create job ad copy, LinkedIn content, or employer brand messaging, not just distribute it
Startup / Scale-Up Navigation: You have delivered results in environments where process, structure, and resources were all still being built
What You'll Work With
AI-powered recruiting infrastructure: The team you'll join builds and operates its own recruiting tooling. You will use it daily.
Modern ATS environment: Structured pipelines, documented stages, KPI tracking built in
LinkedIn Recruiter: Including Recruiter Lite or full seat, depending on search volume
Direct collaboration with a small, senior team, no layers, short decision paths
A technology-first environment where manual workarounds are the exception, not the norm
The operating model follows a clear sequence: first understand, then structure, then automate. Everyone working here works not in individual cases, but within a system.
What's On Offer
Hybrid working model: Berlin base, flexible execution
Real ownership: You design and run your own processes within a clear framework, no micromanagement
Direct access to decision-makers: No approval chains for sourcing decisions or outreach copy
Growth context: You are part of building the internal recruiting capability, not maintaining a legacy setup
Purpose-driven work: Recruiting done properly: structured, skill-based, documented, and fair
Compensation: Salary is discussed transparently during the process, benchmarked against market data. No blanket figures
without basis. If this is relevant for you upfront, mention it in your application, we'll address it directly.
Our Hiring Process
We screen based on skills, not credentials. Here is what to expect:
Application review: A person reads every application, no automated filtering
Short intro call (20–30 min): Context, fit, mutual questions
Skills-based interview (60 min): Structured, competency-specific, with documented assessment
Optional: work sample or personality test: Role-relevant, time-boxed, focused on a real scenario
Final conversation + decision: Transparent feedback regardless of outcome
We aim to respond within 5 business days. If timelines shift, we communicate proactively.

Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work.

We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains.

Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles.

We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.
